title: Clock gear found inside marble in Brazil

tellings.quote: in Brazil, when they're sawing through marble mountains, cutting marble slabs, they find pieces of a clock inside the marble. They even found a gear.

plain: Workers in Brazil cutting slabs out of marble mountains have found pieces of a clock inside the stone, even a gear. That is the account of a man named Kiran Ilum Xenov, who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, and he names no source and gives no date. If true, it would mean some made object got sealed inside rock that formed long before anyone could have built a clock.
